::: {.callout-note .legacy appearance="simple"}
This post is from the blog I kept as Preceptor in Mathematics at Harvard (2005–2008). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

I just got back from the [Legacy of R.L. Moore conference](http://www.discovery.utexas.edu/rlm/Reports/reports.html) in Austin, Texas. It was really nice. The conference is not only about sharing ideas for the Moore method but any Inquiry-Based Learning techniques.

We saw some great talks, especially from the executive director of [Project Kaleidoscope](http://pkal.org/). [Bret](http://www.math.harvard.edu/~benesh/) and I gave a [talk](/files/austinibl.pdf) about our work in the extension school and it was well received.
